messages.author: 07f89408fa615929
messages.subject: Problem with coord_trans - need it to produce nice Forest plot
parts:
Hi,

Has anyone got any idea how I can fix the following:-

The following code works fine:-
ggplot(d, aes(x, y, ymin=ylo,ymax=yhi))+geom_pointrange()+coord_flip()

as does

ggplot(d, aes(x, y, ymin=ylo,ymax=yhi))+geom_pointrange()+coord_flip()
+scale_y_log10()

but what I really want to do is log the y-scale, but keep the unlogged
units on the scale, which is what the following code should do:-

ggplot(d, aes(reorder(x,1/plot_order), y, ymin=ylo,ymax=yhi))
+geom_pointrange()+coord_flip()+coord_trans(y = "log10")


However the resultant plot is completely mangled....

Any ideas?

messages.subject: Re: Problem with coord_trans - need it to produce nice Forest plot
parts:
On Thu, Mar 24, 2011 at 7:15 AM, Jim <james...@glasgow.ac.uk> wrote:
> Hi,
>
> Has anyone got any idea how I can fix the following:-
>
> The following code works fine:-
> ggplot(d, aes(x, y, ymin=ylo,ymax=yhi))+geom_pointrange()+coord_flip()
>
> as does
>
> ggplot(d, aes(x, y, ymin=ylo,ymax=yhi))+geom_pointrange()+coord_flip()
> +scale_y_log10()
>
> but what I really want to do is log the y-scale, but keep the unlogged
> units on the scale, which is what the following code should do:-

Just specify the breaks and labels

ggplot(d, aes(x, y, ymin=ylo,ymax=yhi))+geom_pointrange()+coord_flip()
+scale_y_log10(breaks = 10^(1:5), labels = 10^(1:5))

Hadley
